trap.label: good at + -ing (uso)
trap.wrong: I am good in organize. He is terrible on keeping secrets. She is brilliant to make friends.
trap.right: I am good at organizing. He is terrible at keeping secrets. She is brilliant at making friends.
trap.why: Em português “bom em organizar” e “brilhante para fazer amigos” usam em/para + infinitivo. Em inglês, adjetivo de habilidade + at + -ing.

rewrite.answer: She is brilliant at making friends.
He is terrible at keeping secrets.
